name: B10-0325/2025 (The Left) – Urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the urgent need to protect religious minorities in Syria following the recent terrorist attack on Mar Elias Church in Damascus
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the terrorist attack on the Mar Elias Church in Damascus on 22 June, which killed at least 25 people and injured at least 60. It calls on Syria's transitional authorities to protect religious and ethnic communities, stop sectarian killings and hate speech, and hold perpetrators to justice. It also asks the European Union to draw up a plan to protect religious communities in Syria and urges Member States to reverse their suspension of asylum applications from Syrians. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the EU and Syria's authorities to act.
- **Who it affects:** Syria's religious and ethnic minorities, Syrian refugees, and EU Member States.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions, Member States and the Syrian transitional authorities.
